title: New Super Mario World 1: The 12 Magic Orbs
description: Bowser has stolen the twelve magic orbs from Peach's castle. Do you have what it takes to take them back? This rom hack is an essential test of skill for any serious Mario player looking for a new challenge. Featuring 94 levels, with 112 exits, custom music, new bosses, 9 power ups and more, The 12 Magic Orbs is one of the most comprehensive Mario World rom hacks ever created.
